errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.no_storage: Not enough storage space. Free up space and try again.
errors.file_too_large: File is too large. Maximum size is {{maxSize}} MB.
errors.unsupported_format: This file format is not supported.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: Your documents are safe. Restart the app to continue.

lock.title: Kagazzz Docs is locked
lock.subtitle: Unlock with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to continue.
lock.quick_reference_subtitle: Unlock with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to view your saved values.

root_warning.message: This device looks rooted — your documents may be less secure.

welcome.title: Welcome to Kagazzz Docs
welcome.body: Keep all your important documents safe on your phone. No account needed.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.body: Your files never leave your device. Kagazzz Docs works fully offline.

organize.title: Scan and organize
organize.body: Scan papers into clean PDFs and sort them into folders you choose.

backup.title: Locked and backed up
backup.body: Lock the app with your fingerprint, and export an encrypted backup anytime.

confirmations.delete_message: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

add.title: Add your documents
add.body: Scan paper, pick files or photos. Everything stays on this phone, encrypted.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Search by name — or by words inside your documents, like a PAN or a policy number.

ai.title: Ask your documents
ai.body: The assistant reads, finds and works on your documents — on this phone, not online.

menu.title: Everything else
menu.body: Quick reference, notes, trash, backup and settings live here.

star.title: Star a document
star.body: Tap the star on a document you use often. Starred ones are one tap away in Favorites.

lock.title: Lock the app
lock.body: Turn this on to open Kagazzz Docs with your fingerprint or face.

backup.title: Make a backup
backup.body: An encrypted backup file keeps your documents safe if this phone is lost.

swipe.title: Swipe a document
swipe.body: Slide a document sideways for a quick action.
swipe.change: Change these in Settings → Swipe actions.

select.title: Select several
select.body: Press and hold a document to select it, then tap others — share, move or delete them together.

more.title: Every action
more.body: Tap ⋮ for everything you can do with a document: rename, share, edit the PDF, extract text and more.

quick_reference.title: Quick reference
quick_reference.body: Numbers you copy often — PAN, mobile, bank account — one tap to copy.

quick_notes.title: Quick notes
quick_notes.body: Small things you want fast: a Wi-Fi password, a locker code, a reminder.

archive_trash.title: Archive and Trash
archive_trash.body: Archive keeps old documents out of the way. Deleted ones wait in Trash before they're gone.

backup_menu.title: Back up
backup_menu.body: Make an encrypted backup file now and then, so a lost phone doesn't mean lost documents.

folder_more.title: Folder options
folder_more.body: Tap ⋮ on a folder to rename it, change its colour, reorder it or delete it.

tools_search.title: Find a tool
tools_search.body: Type what you need — "compress", "merge", "photo to PDF".

tools_categories.title: Browse by kind
tools_categories.body: PDF tools, image tools and the rest — tap one to see only those.

tools_op.title: Pick a tool
tools_op.body: Choose a tool, then the document. The result is saved as a new document; your original stays as it was.

viewer_swipe.title: Next document
viewer_swipe.body: Swipe left or right to move through your list. Pinch or double-tap to zoom.

viewer_more.title: Do more with it
viewer_more.body: Share, rename, edit the PDF, extract text, or move it to a folder — all from ⋮.

favorites_star.title: Star it here
favorites_star.body: Tap the star on any document. It shows up in Favorites straight away.
